description: Married beneficiary filing separately who lived with the spouse, MAGI exactly at the separate table's top limit ('greater than or equal to').
worked:
Premium year 2025; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2023 tax return (two years back): 394,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2025 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the table for beneficiaries who are married and lived with their spouses at any time during the year but file separate tax returns: 394,000 is greater than or equal to 394,000.
Part B: standard premium 185.00 + income-related adjustment 443.90 = total monthly premium 628.90.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 85.80 (added to the plan premium).
